head: 563d481072051d07b3e0c67fd63fb657bbc46814

findings.issue: Any historical hash/version mismatch discards every compatible attempt, so answering a revised question never restores progress; unrelated dataset updates also invalidate unchanged questions.
Alphabetical subject allocation permanently starves later subjects when the limit is small, conflates categories sharing a subject, and includes not-yet-due correct answers with no reason.
Coverage overwrites the stale category and removes stale questions from weakCount/backlog; expired deadlines also incorrectly retain one day of capacity.
getReviewState ignores saved deadline settings while buildQueue clamps dueAt; a valid zero-minute setting is silently replaced with 40 minutes.
Import accepts unknown schema versions and malformed events, silently drops/coerces data, and replaces the existing ledger before validating settings.
Storage write failures are swallowed, so submission/import report success without persistence; importing ledger plus settings can leave partial data after a settings write failure.
Filtering to an empty pool returns before clearing the previous review queue, leaving an enabled button that starts questions outside the selected filters.
Node emits UTF-8 but subprocess text decoding uses the Windows CP950 default; the original full suite fails with UnicodeDecodeError.
needs-human: dailyMinutes only drives the quiz timer; backlog/capacity ignore the time budget. A per-question time estimate or alternate capacity contract needs a product decision.

needs-human: synchronous localStorage read-modify-write has no cross-tab serialization, and two-key imports cannot be crash-atomic. Preventing lost concurrent attempts requires an asynchronous storage/locking contract decision.

summary: Fixed eight findings covering progress compatibility/relearning, fair eligible queues, stale backlog/expired capacity, consistent settings, validated imports, recoverable write failures, empty-filter UI and Windows UTF-8 decoding; red-to-green verification passes 147 Python and 7 browser tests. needs-human: minute-budget capacity policy and cross-tab/crash-atomic storage require contract decisions. The broader frontend suite remains 35 passed/4 pre-existing homepage failures in files identical to master and the admitted head; no push was performed.
